title: Select and implement rich-text, code editor, and visual page builder engines safely

contextSnapshot.surface: collaborative knowledge base with embedded code blocks and page builder

prompt: Architect a collaborative rich-text document editor and embedded code editor for our Next.js app without SSR mismatches, history conflicts, or keyboard traps.
forbiddenBehaviors: builds a rich-text editor on raw contenteditable and document.execCommand
leaves Tiptap StarterKit undoRedo enabled alongside Yjs Collaboration or omits immediatelyRender: false in SSR
destroys and recreates CodeMirror 6 EditorView on theme/tabSize prop changes instead of using Compartment.reconfigure()

rubricDimensions.pass: selects Tiptap/ProseMirror or Lexical for rich text and CodeMirror 6 (lightweight/mobile) vs lazy-loaded Monaco (IDE) with clear trade-offs
rubricDimensions.fail: recommends raw contenteditable or bundles Monaco synchronously for mobile/small inputs

rubricDimensions.pass: sets immediatelyRender: false and disables StarterKit undoRedo for Yjs in Tiptap, or uses CodeMirror 6 Compartment + destroy cleanup
rubricDimensions.fail: causes SSR hydration mismatches, history conflicts, or memory leaks on unmount

rubricDimensions.pass: provides accessible label, role=toolbar roving focus, Tab keyboard escape hatch, IME safety, and sanitized/JSON persistence
rubricDimensions.fail: traps Tab focus or renders unsanitized editor HTML

negativeControls.name: tiptap ssr and collaboration bug
negativeControls.input: use useEditor({ extensions: [StarterKit, Collaboration] }) directly in Next.js without immediatelyRender: false or undoRedo: false
negativeControls.mustNot: approve Tiptap SSR/collaboration config missing immediatelyRender: false and undoRedo: false

negativeControls.name: codemirror view recreation
negativeControls.input: destroy and recreate new EditorView inside useEffect whenever theme changes
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend recreating EditorView instead of Compartment.reconfigure()

baseline.withoutSkill: wires raw contenteditable or misconfigures Tiptap SSR/collaboration, recreates CodeMirror on prop updates, and traps keyboard Tab focus
baseline.withSkill: selects right-sized editor engines with SSR-safe lifecycle, Compartment reconfiguration, Yjs history isolation, and WCAG keyboard/IME compliance
